- [ASSISTANT_SAID] You should brace yourself whenever you're doing anything that puts stress on your spine.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Activities that may require you to brace yourself include lifting heavy objects, bending over, sitting for long periods, standing for long periods, and during exercise.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Planks help build core strength and stability; hold for 30 seconds to 1 minute for 3 to 5 sets.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Dead Bugs target deep core muscles; aim for 3 sets of 10 repetitions on each side.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Bird Dogs improve balance and stability; aim for 3 sets of 10 repetitions on each side.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Side Planks work obliques; hold for 30 seconds to 1 minute for 3 sets on each side.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Hollow Body Hold targets deep core muscles; hold for 30 seconds to 1 minute for 3 to 5 sets.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Start slowly and gradually increase the intensity of exercises; stop if you feel pain or discomfort.
